analysis.narrative:
📊 **Consensus:** Mixed sentiment with bearish lean - conviction: medium. Documented near-term headwinds (exchange security failures, ETF outflows, consumer weakness) outweigh forward-looking bullish catalysts (AI/robotics themes, anticipated policy support) that lack concrete confirmation.

📈 **Themes:** (1) AI and robotics secular growth themes attracting institutional focus amid tactical volatility, (2) Policy uncertainty creating fragile conviction - rate trajectory and crypto regulatory clarity as conditional catalysts, (3) Bifurcated market psychology with capital rotating from broad exposure to defined-risk thematic plays.

Near resistance: $627 (54k OI), $625 (41k OI). Near support: $580 (108k OI), $590 (80k OI).
